items.question: By the time we arrived, the concert ___.
items.explanation: Past perfect 'had started' is used for an action completed before another past action.

items.question: She would have passed the exam if she ___ harder.
items.explanation: Third conditional requires past perfect in the if-clause.

items.question: The report ___ by the team before the deadline.
items.explanation: Passive voice is needed because the report receives the action.

items.question: I wish I ___ more time to travel last year.
items.explanation: 'Wish' + past simple expresses regret about a present or general situation.

items.question: Neither the manager nor the employees ___ aware of the change.
items.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject (employees = plural).

modules.title: MET B2 Grammar — Fill the Blank

items.template: If I ___ (know) about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
items.explanation: Third conditional: 'if + past perfect, would have + past participle'.
'Since' is used with a point in time; 'for' is used with a duration.

items.template: The project is expected ___ (complete) by next month.
items.explanation: Passive infinitive: 'expected to be + past participle'.

items.template: Not only ___ the report, but she also presented it.
items.explanation: Negative inversion: when a negative phrase starts a clause, the verb is inverted.

items.template: He suggested that we ___ (take) a different approach.
items.explanation: After 'suggested that', use the base form of the verb (subjunctive).
